decisionsTitle: The «Vii?» card and «Cine vine» are closed folds, and the «Da, vin» link counts you when it opens (amending §812 and §143)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19**, of the event page's «Vii?» card: «Asta ar trebui să fie collapsed, ca și condițiile de participare»; of the link page «Confirmă că vii»: «Asta ar trebui să se auto-bifeze când deschid»; of the public list: «Și aici trebuie să fie la fel: „Cine vine” collapsed».

**Decision.** No new rule, three amendments. **The «Vii?» card (§812) is a closed fold**, the same `<details>` as «Condiții de participare» (§498): the 44-pixel bar, a glyph and a real `h2` in the summary, the id `vin` on the fold itself so a link to `#vin` — the calendar's «Vin! →», the listing's chip, the landing after «Da, vin» — opens it through `OpenFoldFromHash`, and the answer a post leaves in the address (`?vin=…`) opens it on the server so its sentence is read. Its line carries what a reader decides by, in the house's count form: «Vii? · 3 vin», «Vii? · Fii primul care spune că vine.» when nobody has answered, «Vii? · Tu vii ✓ · 3 vin» once the one island (`RsvpRemembered`) knows this browser answered, and nothing about the count while the database is away (§281); inside, the form or the one-tap state, its help, «Nu mai vin» and then «Vin (N)» with the names that may be shown (§143). **«Cine vine» (§143, §250, §396, §628) was already a closed native disclosure** with its count in the title; it now has the same bar as the other two — a real `h2` in the `<summary>`, «Cine vine (N)» on its line (just «Cine vine» when the count is not public), the table, the legend and the notes inside — and keeps its anchor `#start-list-title`, which the pager's links and `OpenFoldFromHash` open. The results section «Clasament» (§809) stays as it is: after a race the results are the point of the page. **The link page of a «Da, vin» message (§811) presses its own button** when a person opens it in a browser: the GET still renders the sentence, the POST form and the button and writes nothing (AGENTS.md §12.8, BR-REQ-036-02 criterion 4), and one small client island (`AutoConfirm`) calls the form's `requestSubmit()` once — only when the page is one a person is looking at, not while the browser prerenders it or its tab is in the background — so the pending label «Te numărăm…» shows and the unchanged POST spends the link, remembers the browser and lands on the event page's open «Vii?» fold. Without JavaScript, and for a mail scanner that runs no scripts, the button stays and counts nobody; the «Nu mai vin» link, a spent, expired or already-counted link keep their press.

**Refused.** An auto-submit from the GET itself, or a link that counts on being fetched (a scanner would count everybody); a fold per part of the card (the form, the count) instead of one; the count only inside the fold (a reader decides by it before opening); folding «Clasament».
changelogLine: - **«Vii?» and «Cine vine» are closed folds, and the «Da, vin» link counts you when it opens** — the card has «Vii? · N vin» (or «Tu vii ✓») on its line, `#vin` and an answer's redirect open it; the list has the same bar with «Cine vine (N)»; the link page presses its own button once in a browser, and keeps the button for a scanner and for no JavaScript. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event page that offers «Vii?» or publishes the participants' list, when it renders, then «Vii?» and «Cine vine» are each one native `<details>` closed on arrival, with a real `h2` in the summary and the count on the line («Vii? · 3 vin», «Vii? · Fii primul care spune că vine.», «Cine vine (3)»), the id `vin` on the card's fold so a link to `#vin` opens it, and the card open on the server when the address carries an answer (`?vin=`); the results section stays as it was (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the page of a live, uncounted «Da, vin» link, when it is requested, then it renders the sentence, the POST form and the button inside one island that presses that button once only while a person is looking at the page, and the request itself writes nothing; the «Nu mai vin» page, a spent, expired or already-counted link draw no island (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the «Vii?» card and «Cine vine» are closed folds with the count on their line; opening the «Da, vin» link counts you without a press
